name: Washing Machine Production Line Solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for washing machine manufacturers, covering the entire process of assembly, inspection, and packaging.
contentHtml:
The washing machine production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for home appliance manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including inner drum assembly, outer shell assembly, shock absorber system installation, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • High degree of line automation
  • Multi-model flexible production
  • Automated inspection ensures quality
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
